projects.title: Polysphere
projects.intro: A visual language for a game — and responsibility for the product.
projects.role: Product ownership, team leadership, visual direction, UI/UX and VFX, as recorded in the original professional history.
projects.proof: Original game footage and a project-specific breakdown of visual and product decisions are being prepared.
projects.status: The preview is illustrative. No unverified performance or business metrics are presented.

blocks.alt: Illustrative vertical case-study layout. Original Polysphere images have not been added.

projects.title: V-ICE
projects.intro: Recover the geometry behind a raster image. Not its staircase of pixels.
projects.role: Research into primitives, shared boundaries, antialiasing, corner classification, stroke consistency and editable vector output.
projects.proof: Raster input → generated SVG → reference comparison. The interactive shape on this site is a synthetic study, not V-ICE output.
projects.status: In development. Low-resolution detail and shape idealization remain active research areas. No production-readiness or competitor-parity claim.

projects.title: Companion / Nervous System
projects.intro: A character to connect with. Not a collection of random animations.
projects.role: Expressive eyes, brows, body language and readable links between your actions and the character’s state.
projects.proof: The intended case study follows an actual session: action → state → expression → response. This site offers a small, locally scripted interaction study.
projects.status: This showcase does not run the Nervous System runtime, long-term memory or learning.

projects.title: Local Party
projects.intro: One shared screen. Phones as controllers. No extra gamepads.
projects.role: Exploring QR joining, personal controllers, shared-screen UI, left- and right-handed layouts, scoring and rounds.
projects.proof: The project case will show a real multi-phone session. This site’s mini race is a single-browser demo against bots.
projects.status: Games are at different stages of development. The network server and QR joining flow are not running in this showcase.

projects.title: El Emental
projects.intro: Visuals, animation, physics and VFX working toward one feeling: magic with weight.
projects.role: Game-feel studies around lifting and throwing stones, destruction, character movement, interfaces and stylized environments.
projects.proof: Original Unity footage will show the action and its layers. The rock here is a separate Canvas interaction study.
projects.status: The original Unity build is not embedded. Build-level performance requires testing in Unity on the target device.

projects.title: Color Prime
projects.intro: Material families, main and accent colours, and a shorter path to an icon.
projects.role: Exploring material inheritance, colour workflows, studio lighting, camera setup and scene preparation for icons.
projects.proof: A repeatable add-on workflow will show one input asset, the artist’s choices and the exported result. The colour study here illustrates the idea.
projects.status: This is not the add-on interface. Time savings have not been measured in this showcase.

projects.title: HexWords
projects.intro: Words on a hexagonal grid. A considered response to every gesture.
projects.role: Swipe interaction, word validation, scoring, hints, DOTween animation and responsive UI.
projects.proof: The case study will show a real swipe, accepted and rejected words, and score feedback. The original build is not embedded here.
projects.status: HexWords / Hex_Module is a separate personal prototype, not Hex Defense.

projects.title: Painterly Rocks
projects.intro: A painted surface that holds its facets, light and sense of volume.
projects.role: Exploring silhouettes, volumetric brush marks and how stylized materials respond to light.
projects.proof: Actual material versions, from the same camera and under the same light, will document the progression.
projects.status: An independent visual study, not a claim to reproduce the original Dreams technology.

projects.title: Fire & Motion
projects.intro: Fire, impact and small particles as one expressive gesture.
projects.role: Stylized fire, evolving volume dissolution, glow and environmental feedback.
projects.proof: Original effect footage and a breakdown of its layers and constraints will be added.
projects.status: Independent research. No claim to use the original Zelda technology.

projects.title: AI Asset Workflows
projects.intro: There is important craft between an AI image and a usable game asset.
projects.role: Generation and editing, background removal, segmentation, part preparation and visual quality control.
projects.proof: A reproducible workflow will show inputs, intermediate stages, manual decisions and final export.
projects.status: Individual experiments, not a claim of a completed production platform.

projects.title: Fluid Experiments
projects.intro: Making complex movement understandable through interaction.
projects.role: Exploring interactive ways to explain the dynamics of fluids.
projects.proof: A focused demonstration will state its mathematical assumptions and what it actually computes.
projects.status: Research in progress. No standalone finished solver or new mathematical result is claimed.

projects.title: Dragon Heist
projects.intro: Character, action and a game outcome you can read through motion.
projects.role: Dragon reactions, button presses, platform and gold-bar movement, wheel states and bonus transitions.
projects.proof: Approved footage will be accompanied by a clear breakdown of personal contributions.
projects.status: Schematic preview only. Original artwork and commercial results require separate approval.

projects.title: Chick Fiesta
projects.intro: A character and interface inspired by a Filipino festival setting.
projects.role: Mobile UI clarity, simpler backgrounds, readable character design, harmless round endings and animation-ready parts.
projects.proof: Approved concept iterations and changes informed by partner feedback will document the work.
projects.status: The preview is not original project art. Release and conversion claims are not made here.

blocks.alt: Illustrative tall-image placeholder for Chick Fiesta. Original project art is not included.

projects.title: Bonus flows
projects.intro: A bonus mechanic that explains itself through timing and sequence.
projects.role: Entry banners, three-window reveals, staggered stops, scale and alpha accents, and the return to the main game.
projects.proof: Original footage and a state diagram will identify the specific contribution.
projects.status: Illustrative preview. No public-release or business-metric claims.
